name: National General Industries Limited
about: National General Industries Limited engages in the production and sale of steel products in India. The company operates in two segments, Manufacturing of Steel and Investments. It offers hot rolled steel rounds, steel squares, and steel flat bars for use in various applications, including bright bar manufacturing, hand tool industry, earthmoving industry, fasteners, ordinances factories, railways, forgings, auto components, heavy engineering industry, agricultural and farm parts, etc. National General Industries Limited was founded in 1954 and is based in New Delhi, India.
